body.name: \overline R_{x,n}(\widetilde q_x;\alpha)
body.construction: For each comparator \(b\), let \(S_b=\sup_{p\in\mathcal C_n(\alpha)}h_{\mathcal M_x(p_x)}(e_b-\widetilde q_x)\), so \(\overline R_{x,n}(\widetilde q_x;\alpha)=\max_{b\in\mathcal A}S_b\). A numerical implementation may report certified primal lower bounds and dual upper bounds \(L_b\leq S_b\leq U_b\). With \(L=\max_bL_b\) and \(U=\max_bU_b\), weak duality gives \(L\leq\overline R_{x,n}\leq U\); only when \(0\leq U-L\leq\gamma\) is verified may it report the conservative certificate \(U\) and certified gap \(U-L\).
